spec.precedence: Blueprint §0 local delivery contract -> Part II (§11-17) -> Part I (§1-10); CLAUDE.md owner decisions override the blueprint where they say so. Use /spec-lookup.

fast: docker compose --profile test run --rm --build backend-test mvn -B -pl <module> -am verify
docker compose run --rm --no-deps frontend sh -c "npm run format:check && npm run build"

overrideGates: A public or player response contains names, bands, attendance or match IDs, roster or guest tokens of other players (privacy-auth.md).
A host route or host mutation has no service-level AccessPolicy.requireHost check, or identity comes from path/body/headers instead of CallerIdentity.
A new route has no rows in GatewayAccessMatrixIT and the owning service's AccessMatrixIT; a non-host response has no JsonAllowlist assertion.
A service reads or writes another service's schema, or SQL concatenates values.
An already-applied Flyway migration was edited, renamed or deleted.
CSRF disabled, CORS wildcard, or guest secret stored or logged in raw form.
A dependency, endpoint, screen, config or copy string not approved in the design was added.
A mutation that can conflict (the design lists a 409 outcome) has no 409 test that also checks row counts are unchanged.
Note: an exact whole-body equality assertion counts as a JsonAllowlist assertion.

docs: the feature implement.md (commands executed, acceptance evidence)
API Document/*.md when a route or error changes
.claude/flow/maps/*.md when a route, table, service or test class is added
planning/README.md and the sprint SPRINT.md row when the status changes
